BiblicalUsage: O my soul, come not thou into their secret, says Jacob, unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united, and the psalmist prays, unite my heart to fear thy name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the prayer turns Jacob's curse into a blessing: he refused to be united with Simeon and Levi's secret, and the psalmist asks God to unite his own heart, and the same word carries the refusal and the request.
